Preserve exact image dimensions, viewpoint, room geometry, all wall-floor and wall-ceiling edges, three-pane window and its exact position and visible garden outside, right-hand door position and shape. Only renovate finishes: replace the old brown carpet with natural pale oak floorboards, paint walls a fresh warm off-white, repaint all baseboards crisp white, replace patterned curtains with simple natural linen curtains in the same curtain positions, repaint the existing radiator clean white, replace the dated hanging lamp shade with a simple opal globe pendant at the exact existing ceiling point. Refinish the closed wooden door in natural light oak without moving it. Keep the room empty, no people or furniture, no text, no logos. Architectural documentary photography with the same soft overcast daylight. This will be used in a before/after slider, so alignment must match exactly.
